explanation: The English article says the war "set the stage for the Second Congo War (1998–2003) due to tensions between Kabila and his former allies", and it spells that out. Kabila moved away from his Rwandan and Ugandan backers, expelled foreign troops and allied with Angola, Zimbabwe and Namibia. The article then says that **"these actions prompted a second invasion from Rwanda and Uganda, triggering the Second Congo War in 1998"**. It adds that some historians view the two wars as one continuous conflict.
